note: OTP Smart (from 18 November 2025): the normal account fee is 1,082 forints a month with electronic statements; a discounted 198 forints applies when income of at least the net minimum wage arrives monthly, which the conditions don't put as a figure, so the game charges the normal fee. Read again 2026-10-30: the Smart account pays 0.01% a year on sight balances; a transfer abroad or in foreign currency online costs 0.35%, at least 4,915 and at most 59,456 forints; a forint transfer at home online 0.35% up to 25,000 forints and a withdrawal at an OTP ATM 99 forints plus 1.53% (both shares the form's home figures can't hold, so not written). Not stated: overdraft, a returned payment, the card's share on another currency, what opening asks.
